lines.name: Shopkeeper
lines.text: Feel free to buy anything you want

lines.name: You
lines.text: Really? Shop? I mean it's cool I guess. Also, when did you get the hat?

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: Oh yeah and my last name is Keeper!

lines.name: Shopkeeper
lines.text: Really?! Everyone else says it makes me look dumb...

lines.name: You
lines.text: yes I am hyped for this

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: WHAT? It wasn't cool enough for you?

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: Okay I don't think you are ready for this though...

lines.name: You
lines.text: Wow, okay, that was really cool!

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: If I could, I would, but I gotta make money somehow...

lines.name: You
lines.text: How much does it cost to sell upgrades? It isn't really something that you manufacture

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: Uh well uh uh uh well...

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: I mean I really shouldn't tell you...

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: But you're pretty awesome, so I'll tell you what I know

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: I just want you to know I have only heard rumors from this parrot and what I say may or may not be true and cannot be used against me in court...

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: Alright. When Parrot's grandfather was alive he saw something he couldn't describe...

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: He said he saw colors he had never seen before

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: His grandfather hopped out of his nest and saw something whiz away

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: Again, he couldn't describe these things...

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: These portals have been here for generations, and they're just a part of life now...

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: But just imagine a world, with no evil portals that go to different dimensions...

lines.name: Shop Keeper
lines.text: I have said too much, it was good chatting with you
